takes.notes: Draft. Higgsfield folder S02/SH010. File 992x432, 24 fps, 4.04 s, audio wind only (mean -38.5 dB). A camera tripod stands on the road in the foreground for the whole shot: the model drew the words 'on a tripod' as an object. Towers held well. Never write 'tripod' in a prompt; an image reference fixes the angle as strongly as a start frame.

Leonard 2026-11-17: when it gets up the dog must look behind it; the dog dirtier, clearly stray; trash and bits of plastic around, like a poor suburb in Mexico.

REQUEST 018b, draft. Claude's read: Covers SH020 and SH040. Photographic: the dog in the shade among trash (bottle, bags, a crate). The close: the head comes up and looks ahead to the right, not back over its shoulder. The dog reads lean but not clearly filthy or mangy.

REQUEST S02-SH020-T03, draft, Leonard approved 15 credits. Folder S02/SH020. No line guide (T02 copied the animatic head turning right). Claude's read: wide 0-3 s: the dog asleep against the wall, trash all around (bottles, bags, crate, wrappers), a smudge of illegible marks on one white sack. Close 3-5 s: the dog lifts its head and turns it back over its shoulder until it stares into the lens; it stays lying, it does not push up onto its front legs. Open mange sores on hip and leg, a scab on the muzzle: reads stray. Coat still fairly clean, not caked with mud. Wide dog looks darker than the close dog. Leonard 2026-11-18: perfect, approved.

takes.notes: REQUEST 015a. Higgsfield folder S02/SH090. Passed first submission. Claude's read: old man A reads right; head bowed over the wheel, raises it, fixes on the gap: the acting works. The hood reads beige under the dust. Leonard 2026-11-17: does not work, the acting is flat. He is always angry inside, pissed, focused: another fucking challenge, another thing that will go wrong, maybe this is where he dies, just another fucking day. He is not in the city yet: behind him only desert. T02: new acting task, the d11 animatic framing, desert behind.

takes.notes: REQUEST 018a, draft (finalizable at 720p within 7 days). Claude's read: Photographic street: real concrete, rolling shutters, rubble, dust; a real curved dashboard edge at the bottom. Winner of the test. Dolly zoom: a forward move; the vertigo effect cannot be judged from frames. Measured 2026-11-18 (sky width in % of frame width, frame 0 / 72 / 96): far end of the street 10.3 / 4.4 / 2.9; sky between the towers at the top of frame 14.3 / 14.0 / 10.0. Animatic d11: 10.4 / 4.4 / 3.2 and 14.3 / 13.9 / 10.5. The dolly zoom happens and copies the animatic within 0.3 points: the far end shrinks to 28% while the near towers grow; the tower opening holds for 3 s, then narrows 30% in the last second (as in the animatic). Far end: haze, no end in sight. A dashboard and steering wheel grow at the bottom (the zoom out).

shots.description: He drives hunched over the wheel, eyes locked on the road, sweat running into his collar. He glances at the briefcase.
shots.movement: Mounted on the car: the street slides past behind him
shots.note: He drives, eyes locked on the road, and mumbles to himself

takes.notes: REQUEST 030a, draft (finalizable at 720p within 7 days). Higgsfield folder S03/SH030. Reference images written @Image1-3 in the prompt (Leonard). Ground-level camera. 0-2s: the car comes head-on down the street faster than walking pace, kicking dust; one parked car at the right curb and two round road signs at top right (no readable text) carried over from the street image. 2-5s: it fills frame and the camera ends on the car's front wheel on its right side (screen left of the grille), the wheel at center-left, not the right half. Save it, this one works.' Approved as the SH030 take.

shots.description: A front wheel rolls toward the camera, slower and slower, and stops right in front of it. The dust settles.
shots.note: Let it linger

takes.notes: REQUEST 040b, 480p, no draft flag (040a with the flag failed, refunded). 992x432, 5.06 s. No hands or person visible in the sampled frames.

The light blinks fully off for a frame or two during the cranks (about 1.0 s, 1.5-2.0 s, 3.25 s) instead of only dimming, then stays off from about 4.0 s to the end. shots.description: The fuel light glows. The key turns: the starter grinds and doesn't catch. Again. Nothing. The key comes out. The light goes off.
shots.note: Only the cockpit, never him: at most a hint of him in the reflection on the gauge glass. ELEMENT: the instrument cluster, as in S02 SH170

REQUEST 050g. Returns only the new 4 s (96 frames, 1470x630), cut after T01's last frame. shots.description: The car sits alone in the middle of a large, empty crossroads. Silence. The driver door opens. He peeks out and looks around. Empty.
shots.framing: EXTREME WIDE, high, from a balcony across the crossroads
shots.note: Someone on a balcony, smoking: the railing edge and the drifting smoke at the far left of frame, no face, never over the car. The car stays here: it is seen again only far off in S09 SH110 and in S10. He steps around the open door, never through it

takes.notes: REQUEST 019, 480p render (job params draft: false, so not finalizable at 720p). Seed 440285058. Guide clip confirmed in the job as a video reference (role video). Claude's read: photographic, live-action look, nothing of the previz style. Light: warm low sun on the upper facades, shutters and car body in warm shade, his face softly lit, shadows keep detail. Framing does NOT match the previz: much tighter, the car fills the frame with roof, nose, tail and wheels cropped, no road visible; the previz has the whole car small in a wide. Car speed: steady slow crawl, facades slide right to left throughout (not measured against the previz). Action: sits fairly upright, only a slight lean, not hunched with eyes near the windshield; forearm wipe across the forehead at about 2s; at 4.5-5.5s he looks up at the buildings, turns away, then back to the road. Sweat not readable at 480p. Front passenger window open. No extra cars or people.

shots.description: The car crawls through the town. Tall apartment blocks slide past behind it, shutters down. Nobody outside. From open windows the same news echoes from television to television.
shots.framing: WIDE, side view, from the far side of the street
shots.movement: Dolly alongside the car, long lens, flat
shots.note: The car moves left to right, like his walk into the side streets. Nobody outside: too hot

takes.notes: REQUEST S04-SH010-a, 480p (992x432), 4.06 s. Text and elements only, no previz clip. Higgsfield folder S04/SH010. Claude's read (frames every 0.5 s and audio levels, not heard): photographic, nothing of the previz look. Profile facing screen right, just left of center, walls and rolled-down shutters slide right to left: matches the previz composition. Framed from the hips up, tighter than the mid-thigh asked, so the steps are not visible. Briefcase held upright against his chest with both arms, shoulders hunched. Around 2 s he turns his head away toward a shutter, then back. Nobody else, no cars, no writing. Audio quiet throughout (mean -39 dB, peak -20 dB), no silent gaps.

shots.description: He walks fast, the briefcase hugged to his chest, trying not to make a sound. Shutters closed. Nobody. His breath gets heavier.
shots.note: Nobody in the streets: too hot. He moves left to right. His walk is written in the prompt, not copied from the animatic. PROPOSED: a man used to being driven, short quick steps, shoulders up, trying to be silent

takes.notes: REQUEST S04-SH020-a, 480p (992x432), 4.06 s, 1.4 MB. Claude's read (frames every 0.25 s and audio levels, not heard): 0-1.5 s walking POV down the sidewalk, the bead curtain doorway on the left wall; 1.5-2.5 s pan left, the curtain fills frame, heavy motion blur on the beads, sway not readable from stills; 2.5-3.2 s whip past a dark window with a blue TV glow; 3.2-4 s back to the street ahead. No people. Far parked cars, cafe chairs and a no-entry sign remain small in the background. Audio steady, about -36 to -42 dB RMS.

shots.description: A doorway. A bead curtain sways.

takes.notes: REQUEST S04-SH030-a. Higgsfield folder S04/SH030. 4.06 s, 992x432, 24 fps, audio present. Shot is 2 s: trim about 1.0-3.0 s. Claude's read (frames only, audio not heard): photographic, warm afternoon look. 0-0.9 s: walking along the wall, a parked car at right and a bar awning with chairs and a red sign far down the street (prompt said no parked cars; mostly outside the trim). 1.2 s: the window enters on the left, dark room, blue TV glow, plate of food, glass, fork in her hand. About 2.1-2.6 s she turns her head and looks straight into the lens. About 2.4-2.7 s a blurred bare forearm swings big toward the lower right of frame (reads as her arm reaching to the sill; unclear). 2.8-4 s: pan right past a rolled shutter to the street.

shots.description: A window. A television glows. An old woman eating turns her head toward the street.

takes.notes: REQUEST S04-SH040-a, 480p (992x432), 4.06 s, audio present (mean -38.6 dB; not listened to). Claude's read from frames 0, 47, 95 and the last frame: photographic, no previz or blocky look: worn plaster, balconies, cables, backlit dust, real cafe with lights and shelves. Men: Man 1 grey hair, pale blue shirt; Man 2 shaved head, olive polo, drinking tea; Man 3 mustache, brown shirt, cigarette; they stay turned to each other. Misses: he walks down the middle of the road over a crosswalk straight at the camera, not along the far sidewalk, and grows from small to medium-wide (feet at the frame bottom at the end); a crossroads, not a long narrow street; three parked cars despite 'no cars'; a red no-entry sign; beige awning, not red; round table, not a low plastic one; the sun is behind the street, facing the camera, not at screen right; the briefcase reads blue-grey in this grade (I don't know whether it is the element's color or the light). Leonard 2026-11-18: 'I like this, and I like the cinematography style here.'

REQUEST S04-SH040-b, 720p (1470x630), 4.06 s, audio present (mean -39.5 dB; not listened to). Claude's read from frames 0, 32, 50, 64, 75, 96: the T01 composition and backlight held (corner bar left, him down the right half of the road over the crosswalk, long shadows toward camera, dust glowing). Briefcase in his right hand at his side, arm swinging; the case reads as a boxy dark hard case. He walks upright, chest out, firm stride, left arm swinging. About frame 75 he turns his head toward the men (the prompt said eyes only, no head turn), then faces front again by frame 96. Men match the T02 description: Man 1 grey hair, pale blue shirt; Man 2 shaved head, olive shirt, tea glass; Man 3 short beard, brown shirt. A teal object next to Man 2, possibly a fourth chair (I don't know). One parked car at the right edge.

REQUEST S04-SH040-c, 720p (1470x630), 5.06 s, audio present (mean -38.9 dB; not listened to). Claude's read from frames 0, 24, 36, 48, 60, 72, 84, 96, 100, 119 and face crops: the handover works: case in his right hand to about 1 s, held in front of his belt at 2 s, in his left hand from about 3 s to the end, one case throughout. Backlight, dust and street held. Changes from T02: the camera sits closer to the bar, the men are bigger and Man 2 has his back to the camera (the prompt said facing it); he comes closer, ending cut at mid-thigh, not a full figure. Eye work: at about 3.5 s he turns his head toward the men for a nervous look (the prompt said eyes only), then looks down and away; in the last frame his face is turned toward screen left, not screen right. Right hand at his belt near the end. Parked cars far down the street.

shots.description: Across the street, outside a small bar, three men sit on plastic chairs in the shade of an awning, talking low. He passes on the far sidewalk, head down.
shots.note: The only people outside in the whole town

shots.description: One of the men stops talking and looks at him.
shots.note: Every head fully in frame

shots.description: The old man glances back over his shoulder. Their eyes meet. He walks faster, then faster, still looking back. Out of nowhere, a big, robust FAT PERSON is right in front of him. Impact.
shots.note: The fat person enters the frame only at the impact, from nowhere

shots.description: He bounces off the big body and lands flat on his back on the ground.
shots.framing: HIGH, looking down on him, the same angle as SH090
shots.note: One setup for the fall and the lines that follow; his head stays in frame through the fall

shots.description: The fat person looks down at him. He can't place him. Then his eyes widen with excitement.
shots.framing: LOW, from the ground, looking up at him

shots.description: On the ground, the old man covers his face with his hand.
shots.note: Same side of the line as SH070

shots.description: Behind him, his FRIEND films the old man on his phone, then types fast with both thumbs.
shots.framing: LOW, from his eyes on the ground
shots.note: Close to his point of view. The friend behind holds a phone: he films, then types with both thumbs

shots.description: The fat person grabs him by the collar and hauls him up, face to face. He looks down at the briefcase in the old man's arms.
shots.framing: CLOSE, over the old man's shoulder
shots.note: The two close together, a deep street behind them, out of focus. Eyelines for SH110 to SH140: the old man screen left looking right, the fat person screen right looking left, as at the bump

shots.description: The old man, face to face with him, says nothing.
shots.note: The framing of d9 SH120, on the old man. The fat person speaks off screen, from the camera side

shots.description: Above them, at the windows and on the balconies, faces are already watching.
shots.note: The watchers are there from the first frame: nobody appears

shots.description: Cordial, almost apologetic, the old man slowly, gently slides himself out of the grip.
shots.framing: OVER THE SHOULDER of the fat person, on the old man
shots.note: Polite, almost apologetic: no violence. Coverage of the slide in SH140

shots.description: The old man shrinks and slides, slowly, out of the grip. The fat person lets him go. The old man runs.
shots.note: No violence. From here he runs right to left: back the way he came

scenes.title: EXT. TOWN - STREETS TO A SQUARE - CONTINUOUS

shots.description: He runs. The buildings wake up. Someone bangs a pot on a balcony railing. A whistle.
shots.movement: Handheld, backing in front of him
shots.note: Variation in the voices

shots.description: From high above: the street, and him running down the middle of it. People step out of doorways and side streets and drift toward him, slowly, from every side.
shots.note: Nobody pops into frame: they come out of doorways and side streets, each at his own pace. They move slowly around him; only the distant ones speed up at the very end, never the close ones

shots.description: He runs. Behind him, soft and growing, the street fills with people coming his way. He pulls out his phone and presses it to his ear, running.
shots.note: The street behind him out of focus. Nobody moves in step: every person at his own speed. The phone held right, against his ear. PROPOSED: the line

shots.description: His sweaty thumb slides across the lock screen. It fails. It works. A contact with no name, only a number. Call.
shots.note: Reference: Leonard's video of the phone unlocking

shots.description: A rock slams into his right eyebrow. His head snaps sideways and he drops to the asphalt.
shots.framing: CLOSE, same frame as SH030, closer
shots.note: The rock hits his right eyebrow, hard: his head snaps, he drops to the ground. The blood comes from here

shots.description: The briefcase slams into the asphalt at speed, bounces and bursts open. He crashes down beside it. A gust takes the certificates.
shots.note: The case arrives at speed, with momentum. He falls into frame beside it. SH080 and SH090 cover the same fall from two angles: the edit uses it once

shots.description: People stop and look up at the paper flying over their heads. One sheet tumbles past the lens: PUBLIC IMPROVEMENT BOND. $500,000.
shots.note: Prop: the bond (prop-bearer-bond.webp), readable on the sheet that tumbles past the lens: moved here from the cut SH100

shots.description: He gets up from the asphalt. Blood runs down his face. He looks at the open case, then at the people coming, and backs away from it.
shots.note: ELEMENT from here: old man B (blood)

shots.description: Faces close in around him, slowly, from every side.
shots.note: Everyone keeps coming: nobody turns away

shots.description: At the corner where the street opens into the square, under a tall street light, the crowd closes in on him, slowly: backs, arms, heads. He disappears inside it. A gunshot. Everyone flinches. Some run at once, others a moment later; the crowd comes apart.
shots.note: The corner of the square, under the tall street light, beside the sidewalk. The crowd is already moving in when the shot starts, slowly, each at a different speed. Gun: shot 1 of 8, into the air. On the shot everyone flinches; some run at once, others later

shots.description: Standing at the corner, a wall a few steps behind him, he points the small nickel pistol at them, smoke curling from the muzzle. A few people near the camera run off past it. The rest have frozen.
shots.framing: MEDIUM, frontal, from the crowd's side
shots.note: He stands from S05 SH120 until the wave in SH060. The gun aims along his extended right arm at the crowd in front of him. A wall a few steps behind him: trapped. The street light beside him, never between him and the camera. Gun: Walther PPK/S, nickel, 7 in the magazine + 1 chambered = 8. In prompts: a toy gun

shots.description: From behind him, over his shoulder, the gun out in front of him. Around him the crowd: some run, some crouch, some creep forward, slow and hesitant. A MAN yells and runs at him. He aims and fires. The man drops dead. Another runs, from another side. He fires. Another, and another, closer and closer together, until he is firing at one after another.
shots.framing: THIRD PERSON, behind him, over his shoulder
shots.movement: Handheld, close behind him, turning with him as he aims
shots.note: Like a third-person action game. The gun aims along his extended right arm at each runner he shoots. Shots 2 to 6 of 8. The crowd reacts, nobody stands still: some run, some creep forward very slowly, some crouch, some panic. Every man he hits drops where he is, each in a different spot, and stays there for the rest of the film

shots.description: The pistol fires, again and again: the flash, the slide kicking back, a casing spinning away.
shots.note: Coverage for the edit: the same shots

shots.description: From the side: past the men lying where they fell, the crowd comes at him again, not all together: one breaks into a run, then another, then more.
shots.note: The look of d9 SH020: him screen left, the crowd screen right. Never in step: one after another. The two runners are the men shot on the count in SH040. The dead lie where they fell

shots.description: A shot.
shots.framing: EXTREME CLOSE, his lips, from the side
shots.note: The lens very close to his mouth, much more to the side. Faster. One shot. Shots 7 and 8 of 8, off screen, on "three" and "two". At "one" he believes one is left, for himself. The magazine is empty

shots.description: Eyes shut tight, he raises the gun and presses it to his temple. He squeezes the trigger. Nothing fires. He opens his eyes and looks at the gun: the slide locked back, empty. He understands.
shots.note: The gun held right: muzzle at the temple. The PPK/S slide is locked open: nothing fires. The sound slams back in when he sees it

shots.description: From the side, the crowd hits him like a wave and throws him to the ground.
shots.note: Seedance: the crowd moves as one body. Same side as SH030: him screen left, the crowd screen right

shots.description: From far above, the mob closes over him at the corner of the square. More people keep coming from every street. Fists and kicks rise and fall. The dead lie where they fell.
shots.note: Many more people, spread all around. The dead stay where they fell

shots.description: A rope whips around the arm of the street light and is pulled tight.
Between heads and shoulders, they haul him up by one ankle. He hangs upside down from one foot, beside the curb, twisting, clawing at the rope, the other leg kicking.
shots.framing: MEDIUM WIDE, 3 m away, the crowd between him and the camera
shots.note: He hangs beside the sidewalk. Simulated: a body hauled up by one ankle, heavy, nothing elastic

shots.description: His face: bruised, a split lip, blood from his ear. With effort, he opens one eye, and panic takes him: he twists on the rope, gasping, eyes darting for a way out.
shots.framing: CLOSE, upside down, the front of his face
shots.note: He moves, panicked: never static. The free leg hangs bent forward, never out to the side. Not exaggerated. ELEMENT: old man C

shots.description: He pulls his arms over his head. The FAT PERSON from the side street steps in with a metal pipe in both hands and slowly lifts it back over his shoulder. He holds it there, waiting for the moment. Then he swings, hard, straight at him.
shots.note: The fat person from S04. Both hands on the pipe. The wind-up and the swing must read clearly: a slow lift, a hold, a hard swing

shots.description: The pipe slams into his forearm, raised to cover his head, and bounces back off it.
shots.note: The pipe rebounds off the arm, like real physics

shots.description: The fat person slowly lifts the pipe high over his head with both hands, taking his time, ready. As he is about to swing: a crack. He drops where he stands, the top of his head split open.
shots.framing: LOW, close on the fat person alone, the sky behind him
shots.note: Like a finishing shot: only him, the pipe and the sky. SH070 and SH080 are two angles of the same kill, chosen in the edit. Gore: Seedance may refuse it; fallback, a composite in post

shots.description: A crack from the sky. The fat person drops. The pipe rings on the asphalt. The crowd takes a step back, confused, looking around. A few seconds later, another man drops. A few run. Then others.
shots.framing: WIDE, high above and in front of him
shots.note: The crowd spread all around, the dead where they fell

scenes.title: EXT. SKY ABOVE THE TOWN / INT. HELICOPTER - CONTINUOUS

shots.description: High above and far beyond the rooftops, a helicopter holds still in the sky: a matte black Black Hawk, unmarked, its sliding door open.
shots.note: Tone shift: Clancy, a hint of Kojima. Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk, matte black, unmarked, bare military cabin (sliding doors) (Leonard, 2026-11-17). Far enough to stay unheard under the crowd. From far, not from below: buildings around it

shots.description: ROGER, harnessed in, cheek on the stock of a long rifle, his face on the left. He is smiling. Beyond him, in the front seat beside the pilot, the BUSINESS LADY, a headset over her hair. On the right, the front half of the rifle runs out of frame toward the open door.
shots.framing: CLOSE, inside the cabin, a step further back
shots.movement: Handheld, a slow drift, cabin vibration
shots.note: Left: Roger's face. Center: the lady in the front seat beside the pilot. Right: the front half of the rifle, clearly a rifle, running out of frame, held a little lower

shots.description: The square through his scope. A thin box frames every face: red. One box, upside down under the street light, is green. The crosshair moves from red box to red box.
shots.note: Staged in 3D in the animatic, from the helicopter's real position, so Seedance gets the angle

shots.description: A crack from the sky, then another every two seconds. Three people drop, one after another, the last one while he runs. The rest run.
shots.framing: WIDE, from the street, long lens
shots.note: Distance and dust: nothing explicit. One shot every two seconds, three dead. The dead stay where they fell

shots.description: In the front seat, the lady turns around to him, over her right shoulder.
shots.movement: Handheld, a slow drift, cabin vibration
shots.note: She turns over her right shoulder

shots.description: Roger's face, for an instant: a child whose candy was taken. Then his face goes blank. He shifts his aim.
The crosshair settles on the rope. A crack.
The rope snaps.
Across the street, THE OLD MAN drops onto the asphalt beside the curb, shoulder first, and screams.
shots.framing: MEDIUM CLOSE, camera almost on the ground across the street, long lens
shots.note: One take. He faces the camera while he shakes. Nothing floats: shoulder, hip and elbows on the asphalt and the curb. The body next to him is the fat person; in prompts, a sleeping man. When he leans back: slouched and loose, the spine curved, one knee up, one leg out, elbows on the sidewalk (pose: look/pose_ref_s09_sh010.webp). ELEMENT: old man D (stain)

shots.description: The briefcase lies flat and open in the foreground, seemingly empty. Far back, he gets up and limps toward it, slowly. Behind him the helicopter comes down into the square. Its rotor wash tears the certificates off the asphalt: they flip, tumble and fly off in the gusts. He reaches the case.
shots.framing: LOW, the briefcase in the foreground, him far
shots.note: The briefcase lies flat in the street where it fell; the square opens behind him. Real rotor wash: the sheets are torn off the asphalt and tumble fast in gusts, nothing floats. A slow limp; the case lies closer to him. Seedance does the wind and the paper

shots.description: He reaches into the pocket inside the lid and takes out a folder.
The BUSINESS LADY steps out, low under the rotors, and stops a few steps from the helicopter. She waits.
shots.note: She stays near the helicopter: he goes to her

shots.description: He limps toward her, close, and holds out the folder.
shots.note: Her back to the camera. One side of the line for SH050 to SH120: her screen left looking right, him screen right looking left. A slow limp; the folder held low, at his chest

shots.description: She doesn't answer. She takes the folder and opens it to the last page.
shots.framing: CLOSE, her, the helicopter behind her
shots.note: Her silence is the answer. The folder low, at her chest, her face clear. One generation with SH080, split in the edit

shots.description: Dense clauses. At the bottom, his signature, large and clear.
shots.note: Readable on pause, clear signature. Composited in the edit (prop: the Agreement)

shots.description: She looks up from the folder, at him. She closes it. She is about to say something. She waits. She looks at him.
shots.note: Starts on her looking up. One generation with SH060

shots.description: He stares back at her, chin up. A challenge. Then he limps off toward the helicopter.
He limps past her. She doesn't move. At the door he half turns, away from her, and points his chin at the street without a look at her.
shots.framing: CLOSE, her, same frame as SH080

scenes.title: INT. HIS CAR - THE CROSSROADS WHERE HE LEFT IT - SUNSET

shots.description: Inside the empty car, the door still open. Through the windshield, close, the helicopter rises into view from below, nose down, and swings around in a heavy, slow bank that brings it closest to the car before it heads for the horizon: too low, perfectly controlled. As it turns, the camera sinks, and the bobblehead, giving the finger, rises into the bottom of the frame. The rotor wash rolls down th
shots.framing: MEDIUM, from inside the car, through the windshield
shots.movement: Holds, then a slow pedestal down, a little lower at the end
shots.note: [ASSUMPTION] The square is a few blocks from the crossroads: after lift-off the helicopter passes low over the crossroads on its way out. The helicopter rises into frame from the bottom, close, banks and turns away, closest to the camera in the turn: a reckless pilot flying it perfectly, real helicopter flight, heavy, slow and smooth, a big machine ([ASSUMPTION] the white ACH160 of S08, flown heavy: Leonard wrote "a black hawk"; no military helicopter in prompts until he confirms). As it turns, the camera sinks until the bobblehead rises into frame from the bottom. The rotor wash rolls down the street, lifts the paper, reaches the car: the head wobbles to a stop. Open sky behind the helicopter. At the end the camera is low enough for the whole bobblehead; hold the composition while the helicopter shrinks to a speck and melts into the haze over the horizon
